post.title: How to Create a Post
post.step1: Click "Create" in the top navigation bar and select "Post" to start creating a post.
post.step2: Enter the title and description, optionally upload media or embed a link, and set the date, time, and post type.
post.step3: Enhance the visibility of your post by categorizing them under an event, organization, timeline, or location. Click "Create Post" to finalize and publish your post.

event.title: How to Create an Event
event.step1: Click "Create" in the top navigation bar and select "Event" to start creating an event.
event.step2: Fill in the event title, description, and optionally upload cover photo. Set the date, time, and location of the event.
event.step3: Enhance the visibility of your event by categorizing them under an event, organization, timeline, or location.
event.step4: Select the event type — Past, Live, Upcoming, or Indefinite. Fill out the necessary details, and click "Create Event" to finalize and publish your event.

organization.title: How to Create an Organization
organization.step1: Click "Create" in the top navigation bar and select "Organization" to start creating an organization.
organization.step2: Enter the organization name, and fill out the necessary details. Click "Create Organization" to finalize and create your Organization.
organization.step3: Structure your Organization Timeline by adding time blocks, including details like bio, cover photo, location, logo, or name. Click "Publish Timeline" to finalize and publish your organization’s timeline.

timeline.title: How to Create a Timeline
timeline.step1: Click "Create" in the top navigation bar and select "Timeline" to start creating an timeline.
timeline.step2: Enter the timeline name, and fill out the necessary details. Click "Create Timeline" to finalize and create your timeline.
timeline.step3: Build your Timeline by adding time blocks with details like events, organizations, or timelines. Click "Publish Timeline" to finalize and publish your timeline.

contribute.title: How to Contribute
contribute.step1: Click "Contribute" in the timeline of a Profile Page, Organization Page, Timeline Page, Event Page, or Game Event Page and select the type of contribution you want to make, such as a Post, Event, or Timeline.
contribute.step2: The selected timeline is autofilled in the form. Fill out the remaining fields, and submit your contribution to the chosen timeline.

contentType.title: How to Define Your Content Type
contentType.step1: Click "I Was There" to contribute your firsthand experience of an event or moment you witnessed.
contentType.step2: Click "Contributing to History" to share details about an event or moment you didn't witness but want to document as part of history.
